title: YEEZY BOOST 350 V2 GID
description: Regarded as a cultural phenomenon, the adidas Yeezy Boost 350 silhouette generated a cult following when it was initially released in 2015. This ‘Glow’ makeover—released in May 2019—equips the Primeknit upper with a high-visibility treatment and a translucent stripe to the lateral profile. Integrated lacing and a coordinating heel pull provide easy on/off. Underfoot, the signature full-length Boost midsole looks to the future with a bright glow in the dark finish.

title: YEEZY SLIDE INFANTS
description: The adidas Yeezy Slide Infant ‘Enflame Orange’ dresses the minimalist slip-on in a bold citrus hue. The lightweight sandal is crafted from injected EVA foam and features a soft footbed marked with adidas’ three stripes logo, representing the only instance of exterior branding. An adjustable strap wraps around the heel for an extra-secure fit. Underfoot, a series of deep grooves are carved into the outsole, delivering a blend of impact protection and grippy traction.

title: YEEZY FOAM RUNNER
description: The adidas Yeezy Foam Runner ‘Ochre’ complements its futuristic aesthetic with a subdued, monochromatic finish. A dark beige hue suffuses the one-piece foam build, featuring ventilation ports of varying shapes and dimensions that enhance breathability while adding depth to the slip-on’s flowing lines. ‘FOAM RNNR’ is debossed on the interior collar, alongside the shoe size and ‘Made in USA’ branding. Underfoot, the outsole features a wavy traction pattern for reliable grip.

title: YEEZY BOOST 700 MNVN INFANTS
description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 700 MNVN Infants ‘Phosphor’ showcases an eye-catching hue on the sneaker’s one-piece polyester upper. The high-visibility finish is augmented with reflective silver accents, including the oversized ‘700’ plastered across the sneaker’s lateral side panel. Under the foot, responsive cushioning comes courtesy of a full-length Boost unit, encapsulated within a black PU midsole and herringbone rubber outsole.

title: Logan Run Boot
description: Background: Designed by Nick Daiber & Strah, nicknamed after the sci/fi novel and film "Logan's Run," the foam hiker boot was initially one of many foam footwear concepts made by the Yeezy team in Wyoming. However, of all the concepts, apart from the foam runner, this boot saw the most development with "over 50" (per @archiving.ideas) colorways and multiple versions. The mold of the sole for the boot was even brought back for experimenting in Yeezy Season 9 footwear.
